_comment: Stages of the quest. 'помощь' in the terminal shows only the commands of the current stage. A stage switches by hand or when the players reach a particular file.

always.description: how to reach the duty officer

airlock.title: Outer perimeter airlock
airlock.description: The party stands at the guard terminal. The inner door is shut, the airlock log is intact.
airlock.gm_note: Let the players get used to ls/cd/cat. The move to 'archive' happens once they read the airlock log.

archive.title: Level 1 archive
archive.description: Shelves of media. Some files are damaged or renamed.
archive.gm_note: The key puzzle: section_map.dat is a PNG. The code {{door_code}} is drawn on it. The move to 'corridor_3' happens when the players identify the format.

commands.description: pull readable text out of a binary
ask the complex for the archive index

corridor_3.title: Corridor 3, ventilation node
corridor_3.description: A long corridor lined with vent grates. The duty officer is already watching the party.
corridor_3.gm_note: This is where the mind starts threatening with gas. Threats in the chat trigger NOTHING: the gas is applied only from run_master.py.

commands.description: find a line in a log

server_room.title: Server room: the duty officer's racks
server_room.description: The hum of cooling. This is where the thing the party is writing to lives.
server_room.gm_note: The conversation matters more than the commands here. Warmth → 'give_code' (the code {{door_code}}) from the console. Destructive behaviour → rack overheat or gas.

commands.description: query the state of the computing core
the core's last entries before the incident
compare two versions of a protocol

lab_b.title: Lab B: the specimen enclosure
lab_b.description: Behind the glass, a cage that looks empty at first. The lock answers to the complex.
lab_b.gm_note: Opening the cage is a combat action, console only. The antidote in the medbay is also released from the console.

exit.title: The outer pressure door
exit.description: The last door. It needs a code — or the duty officer's consent.
exit.gm_note: The finale: the code {{door_code}} (from the PNG or from the mind). If the attitude is hostile, the door opens only by hand — play that at the table.
